name: Greater Cryostasis
primary:
A zone at the aim point with a 3.9-block radius for 14 s. Every second, on everyone inside, including you (damage and control only hit enemies):
• Cold 80: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• Heals 2 ❤
• Regeneration: +1 ❤ every 2 s for 8 s
• Growth: up to 4 nearby blocks — crops +2 stages, dirt turns to grass, roots grow upward
• Stone skin (Resistance II) for 4 s
